comments.run_failure_no_credential: it started without a daemon credential, so it could not fetch its prompts

comments.run_failure_network_closed: the pod's network never opened toward the daemon within 60 s (check the tenant NetworkPolicy)
comments.stage_no_agent: **{stage}** has no agent for this task. Pick one in the task's **Agent** field, or in its project's stage template, and relaunch the stage.
comments.agent_type_not_found: The agent **{agent}** assigned to **{stage}** does not exist. Pick another in the task's **Agent** field.

comments.deps_resolved: All blocking dependencies are done: the task is no longer blocked.
comments.auditor_launch_failed: Stage **{stage}** — the auditor could not start ({err}); the task is blocked until someone checks it.
comments.auditor_no_verdict: Stage **{stage}**: the auditor ended without a verdict (exit {code}, instance `{instance}`); the task is blocked until someone checks it.
comments.auditor_queued: Stage **{stage}**: the auditor is waiting for room ({reason}). It starts on its own, or gives up after {minutes} min.
comments.launch_bad_stage_id: Cannot launch: stage id {stage:%q} is not a valid slug ([a-z0-9_], max 32 chars).

comments.run_queued: Queued: **{agent}** in **{stage}** is waiting: {reason}. It starts on its own when there is room; moving the task cancels the wait.
comments.run_queue_lost: The daemon restarted while **{agent}** in **{stage}** was waiting for room, and that wait cannot be picked up again. Relaunch the stage or send the message again.

launch_blocked.other: Launch blocked — {count} credentials this task needs are not usable:

comments.mention_queued: @{agent} is waiting for room ({reason}). It answers when room frees up in the workspace, or gives up after {minutes} min.

mention_dropped_queue.other: ({count} waiting messages were dropped; mention it again)

comments.runner_failed: Runner {runner} could not run the agent: {err}
comments.runner_lost: Runner {runner} stopped answering (or never took the run), so the run failed. Check that `thulu runner run` is up on that machine
comments.hours_spent: Did not start: this workspace used the {included} agent hours its plan includes for {period}, and the plan has no extra hours. New runs can start again on {resets}, or a workspace admin can raise the cap on extra hours in Settings.
comments.hours_cap_reached: Did not start: this workspace reached its ${cap} cap on extra hours for {period} ({extra} extra hours). A workspace admin can raise the cap in Settings, or new runs can start again on {resets}.
comments.trial_ended: Did not start: the 30-day trial ended on {trial_end}. Pick a plan to keep running agents. The workspace stays readable, and `octopus export` works for 30 more days.
comments.trial_hours_spent: Did not start: this workspace used the {included} agent hours of its 30-day trial. Trial hours do not renew with the month. Pick a plan to keep running agents; everything in the workspace stays as it is.
comments.plan_inactive: Did not start: this workspace has no active plan (the subscription ended or a payment failed). The workspace stays readable; runs start again once the plan is active.
comments.hours_notice_80: This workspace used 80% of the {included} agent hours its plan includes for {period} ({used} h so far). Runs keep going: after the included hours, each extra hour costs $0.05, up to the workspace's ${cap} cap.
comments.hours_notice_80_no_extra: This workspace used 80% of the {included} agent hours its plan includes for {period} ({used} h so far). When they run out, runs already going finish and new runs wait until {resets}.
comments.hours_notice_80_trial: This workspace used 80% of the {included} agent hours of its trial ({used} h so far). When they run out, runs already going finish and new runs need a paid plan. The trial ends on {resets}.
comments.hours_notice_100: This workspace used all {included} agent hours its plan includes for {period}. From now on each extra hour costs $0.05, up to the workspace's ${cap} cap; past the cap, new runs wait until {resets}.
